purpose: Bind the retained assistant/SFT and reward-prompt inventories for downstream data studies while separating structural validity, verified outcomes, tool trajectories and fixed-policy RL feasibility.
evidence_boundary: This manifest records structural census and bounded prompt/reference evidence only. Serializable conversations are not verified supervision, query-only prompts are not RL trajectories, and no source is admitted or training authorized.

common_contract.stage: post_training SFT and conditional fixed-policy RL feasibility
common_contract.source_family: Preserve publisher/source, subset, prompt family, teacher/reference family and derived outcome family separately.
common_contract.transformation_type: Structural chat serialization, outcome-verification selection and rollout/reference generation are distinct operations.
common_contract.quality_vector: Record structural validity, task/category/length strata, independent outcome status, tool schema validity and unresolved/rejected reasons.
common_contract.dependency_metadata: Tool trajectories retain schemas, turn order, observations, outcomes and recovery cases; query-only RL rows retain reference/test links when present.
common_contract.contamination_status: open; exact prompt overlap and source labels do not establish benchmark-family clearance.
common_contract.lineage: Bind source revision/configuration, teacher/reference identity, generation settings, verifier identity and rejected-row reasons.
common_contract.unique_tokens: Supervised and context tokens must be counted after final serialization and masks; current receipt provides structural rows and sampled lengths, not a launch token total.
common_contract.exposure_tokens: not set; SFT target remains 1.5M qualified conversations only as a working hypothesis.
common_contract.repetition_count: not set; repeated tasks/prompts require explicit family and exposure accounting.

sft_inventory.context_sample_boundary: 256-row samples report complete serialized rows at 4K/16K/32K/128K. These samples do not establish population token distributions or answer correctness.

sft_source_families.lineage_status: source identity only; generation/verification lineage open
source identity only; teacher/source lineage open

sft_source_families.outcome_status: not independently verified in this receipt
sft_source_families.lineage_status: subset identity present; teacher/source lineage open
subset identity present; environment/trajectory provenance open

rejection_families: tool calls with non-reasoning prose needing adapter
tool_and_agent_findings.interpretation: Structural rejection is a format/adapter signal, not a quality ranking. Tool rows cannot enter SFT or RL without schema, turn-order, observation, outcome and recovery checks.

rl_prompt_inventory.source_lineage: All inspected source labels name only UltraData-RL-2609; row-level upstream attribution unresolved.
rl_prompt_inventory.boundary: Full Math/Knowledge lanes and convenience Code/Long_Context prefixes only. Query-only lengths exclude chat/rollout overhead. Complete line/schema/test-array validity does not establish correctness, independent oracle strength, family/benchmark exclusion, useful context, source rights, qualified RL runtime or successful SFT traces. No source code/tests/tools executed; no task text displayed. Prompt overlap uses exact normalized first-user strings only.
rl_prompt_inventory.status: fixed-policy feasibility candidate only; no policy updates or RL admission

study_contract.sft: Compare candidate-pool selection with outcome-verification selection from matched task/length strata, same parent, masks, supervised-token target and evaluation families.
study_contract.rl: Use fixed-policy rollouts only after SFT selection; validate verifier reliability, non-vacuous controls, solvable/unsolvable strata, recovery and held-out transfer.
not_allowed: mixing tool adapters into only one SFT arm without accounting
using query-only length as chat/rollout length
claiming RL-data value from fixed-policy feasibility alone
using prompt overlap as full contamination clearance

required_before_first_arm: Named source-use and component/teacher/reference lineage decisions.
Task, source-family, prompt-family and final-evaluation partitions.
Final chat serialization, assistant masks, supervised-token counts and context ceiling without silent truncation.
Independent code/math/tool outcome checks and explicit unresolved/invalid handling.
Tool schemas, turn order, observations, outcomes, failure/recovery cases and environment identity for agent rows.
Pinned RL references/tests/verifiers with deliberately wrong controls and fixed-policy cost measurement.
Useful parent checkpoint and measured downstream runtime within the 150-hour research reservation.
next_actions: Split the 500K structural census into source-family manifests and remove prompt/task families crossing held-out boundaries.
Audit a bounded stratified SFT panel for correctness, reasoning style, tool validity, assistant density and outcome evidence.
Qualify the agent subsets or exclude them from the first SFT arm when adapter/schema/recovery gaps remain.
Bind RL prompt/reference families, verifier controls and rollout cost before fixed-policy feasibility.
Keep all rows outside post-training arms until a revised manifest closes lineage, outcome, partition and token-count gates.
admission_boundary: This is a launch-blocked downstream candidate manifest. It does not admit SFT rows, trajectories or reward prompts, authorize policy updates or change the post-training budget.
